entities.summary: Charles Augustine González is an American Democratic politician from Texas. He represented Texas's 20th congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1999 to 2013. He served as Chairman of Latinos for Obama and National Co-chair of President Obama's 2012 re-election campaign.
